headline: Nigeria Interbank FX Volume Plunges 82% as Naira Weakens to Record Low
summary: Interbank foreign exchange turnover crashed 82% to $164.28 million as the Nigerian naira weakened to N1,396.50/$, its weakest official closing level in nearly nine months.
why: Foreign exchange liquidity shortages and currency depreciation impact import costs and foreign reserve management in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Sharp drops in interbank liquidity coincide with official exchange rate depreciation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Severe liquidity contractions in the interbank foreign exchange market reduced transaction volumes and pushed the currency to multi-month lows.
